{{nihongo|'''Nogita Shrine'''|乃伎多神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

=== Shrine crest ===
Left triple tomoe

=== History ===
Founding period unknown. It is a candidate shrine (Shikinaisha ronsha) for "Nogita Shrine" in {{ill|Ika District, Shiga|it|Distretto di Ika|ja|伊香郡|ko|이카군|zh|伊香郡|qid=Q1042353}}, {{ill|Ōmi Province|ca|Província d'Ōmi|ckb|پارێزگای ئۆمی|cs|Provincie Ómi|de|Provinz Ōmi|es|Provincia de Ōmi|fa|ولایت اومی|fi|Ōmin provinssi|fr|Province d'Ōmi|gl|Provincia de Ōmi|hak|Ōmi-koet|id|Provinsi Ōmi|it|Ōmi|ja|近江国|ko|오미국|lt|Omio žemė|nl|Omi (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Ōmi|pt|Província de Ōmi|ru|Оми (провинция)|simple|Ōmi Province|sk|Ómi (provincia)|sr|Провинција Оми|tr|Ōmi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Омі|vi|Tỉnh Ōmi|zh|近江國|zh_min_nan|Ômi-kok|zh_yue|近江國|qid=Q843882}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}<ref>Other candidates include a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=shrine of the same name}} in Higashimononobe, Takatsuki-chō, same city.</ref>. It was under the protection of Ahe Awaji-no-kami, a vassal of the {{ill|Azai clan|Q1872031|qid=Q1872031}}, but was lost to fire in the {{ill|Battle of Shizugatake|Q225562|qid=Q225562}}. The current shrine buildings were built in {{ill|1797|Q7820|qid=Q7820}} (Kansei 9). In {{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 9), it was ranked as a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.
